card.title: Director IT-  Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology
card.description:
We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. 

 For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

 Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?
 


 The IT Director- Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology is a senior technology leader within the Business Technology Management group responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise systems that enable manufacturing, supply chain, and operations. This role requires deep experience in the manufacturing and supply chain verticals, with expertise in SAP ECC–based ERP environments and tightly integrated operational technologies.
 Serve as the strategic bridge between Manufacturing, Supply Chain Operations, Corporate Development, and IT—ensuring that core platforms such as SAP ECC, SAP Ariba, SIOP planning solutions, MES, TMS, and WMS ecosystems are optimized to drive reliability, cost efficiency, service levels, and scalability.
 
 Technology Strategy & Roadmap 
 Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for manufacturing and supply chain systems aligned to business growth objectives.

 Own the strategy and lifecycle management of SAP ECC across production planning (PP), materials management (MM), sales & distribution (SD), quality management (QM), plant maintenance (PM), and OTC integrations

 Ensure alignment between ERP, procurement, planning, and shop-floor systems to enable end-to-end process visibility.

 Evaluate and modernize SIOP planning capabilities to improve forecast accuracy, capacity planning, and inventory optimization.

 
 Manufacturing Systems Leadership 
 Lead strategy and governance for MES platforms, ensuring tight integration between shop-floor control systems and SAP ECC.

 Drive digitization initiatives across production, quality, maintenance, and traceability.

 Oversee WMS and TMS platforms to ensure seamless warehouse execution, logistics optimization, and transportation visibility.

 Improve plant-level KPIs through system enablement and data integrity.

 
 SAP & Supply Chain Optimization 
 Oversee end-to-end integration between SAP ECC , SAP Ariba , SIOP planning tools, and TMS

 Ensure procurement workflows, supplier collaboration, and spend management are optimized within Ariba.

 Drive master data governance across materials, BOMs, routings, vendors, customers, and logistics networks.

 Partner with Finance to ensure accurate cost accounting, inventory valuation, and manufacturing variance reporting.

 
  O perational Excellence & Reliability 
 Working within our established IT Operating Model, establish strong IT-business governance with manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement leadership.

 Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance across mission-critical operational platforms.

 Lead continuous improvement initiatives

 Implement strong change management practices to ensure adoption across plant and warehouse environments.

 
 Team & Vendor Leadership 
 Build and lead high-performing ERP, Manufacturing, OTC, Product Lifecycle Management and supply chain technology teams (internal and external).

 Manage system integrators, managed services providers, and software vendors.

 Establish clear SLAs and performance metrics for operational support and project delivery.

 Develop internal capability in SAP ECC manufacturing and supply chain modules.

 
 Minimum Job Requirements 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, or related field or equivalent experience
 
 Work Experience 
 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience in the manufacturing sector

 Deep hands-on functional and technical expertise in SAP ECC 

 Proven experience implementing and optimizing MES, WMS, and TMS solutions within complex manufacturing environments.

 Demonstrated experience leading SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) system enablement.

 Experience integrating SAP Ariba with SAP ECC environments.

 Strong understanding of manufacturing costing, supply chain planning, inventory optimization, and logistics execution

 
 Knowledge / Skills / Abilities 
 Deeply knowledgeable in manufacturing operations and plant-floor realities—not just enterprise IT.

 Fluent in SAP ECC manufacturing and supply chain processes.

 Data-driven and operationally rigorous.

 Capable of translating operational strategy into scalable technology solutions.

 Comfortable operating in complex, multi-plant environments where uptime and execution discipline are critical.

 
 Preferred Job Requirements 
 
 Education 
 MBA
 Work Experience 
 5+ years of ERP leadership in an organization executing acquisitions
 “We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.”

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office. 
 

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**SUMMARY**

Regal Rexnord is seeking a hands-on Plant Manager to serve as the operating leader for its filament-bearing production facility in Downers Grove, Illinois. The site manufactures filament-wound composite bearings for aerospace, defense, and heavy-industry applications. This position combines daily production management with overall facility leadership and accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, maintenance coordination, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will translate customer demand into clear daily priorities, lead disciplined execution within an AS9100-certified quality management system, develop frontline employees, and establish a visible, fact-based operating rhythm. This role requires strong floor presence, sound judgment, and the ability to solve problems at their source without compromising safety or compliance.

 
 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead daily and weekly production execution, including staffing, work-center priorities, material readiness, equipment availability, schedule attainment, and recovery planning.
* Provide senior on-site leadership for routine facility operations and maintain clear ownership for safety, housekeeping, 5S, emergency readiness, contractor activity, and general facility condition.
* Lead a proactive safety culture through employee engagement, hazard identification, floor observations, incident and near-miss follow-up, and timely corrective-action closure.
* Ensure production complies with the AS9100 quality management system, approved work instructions, specifications, inspection plans, traceability requirements, record controls, and change-management processes.
* Partner with Quality to contain nonconforming product, protect customers, complete root-cause analysis, implement corrective action, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and hold accountable approximately 25 direct labor and maintenance employees; establish expectations for safety, quality, attendance, teamwork, productivity, and conduct.
* Build staffing, skills, cross-training, and succession plans; ensure employees are trained and qualified before performing assigned work.
* Prioritize maintenance activity based on safety, quality, production risk, and customer need; improve preventive-maintenance discipline and eliminate recurring equipment failures.
* Use daily visual management and tiered escalation to review safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and equipment performance.
* Lead continuous-improvement activity that increases throughput, reduces lead time and inventory, improves labor productivity, and lowers the cost of poor quality.
* Manage controllable spending, overtime, supplies, maintenance expense, and operating variances within delegated authority.
* Provide the General Manager with clear operating updates covering performance, risks, recovery actions, resource needs, and decisions required.
 

 

**Critical Competencies**

* Demonstrated ability to manage safety, quality, production, delivery, labor, maintenance priorities, and operating metrics in a regulated or high-reliability environment.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 or a comparable structured quality management system, including nonconformance control, corrective action, document control, traceability, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP or production-planning systems and the ability to interpret schedules, routers, work instructions, drawings, specifications, inspection information, and operating data.
* Strong communication, structured problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work regularly on the production floor and respond to operating issues outside normal administrative hours when required.
 

 

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant manufacturing leadership experience.
* Five or more years of progressive manufacturing experience, including at least three years leading production employees or manufacturing teams.
 

 

Restrictions imposed by federal export control laws may limit this job opportunity to candidates who are a ‘U.S. Person,’ which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted asylum in the United States, refugees in the United States, or individuals who otherwise qualify for a license permitting them to hold the position.

 
 
 

Expected salary: $110,000 – $129,000 annually + a 10% bonus

The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company's base pay compensation for this position. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, the geographic market of that location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education and internal peer compensation comparisons among other potential factors.

 

**Physical Demand and Work Environment**
========================================

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* + **Physical Demands -** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand. The employee frequently is required to walk; use hands to manipulate, handle, or feel; reach with arms; and talk or hear. The employee must be able to lift and manipulate up to 50 pounds and occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Must be able to occasionally stand for a portion of shift. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Per AS9100 requirements, an up-to-date vision test should be made available to management and may be shared with auditors.
 + **Work Environment** - The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise levels in the work environment are usually moderate. However, in some instances this job does require work in areas where ear protection is necessary. The use of safety glasses and safety toe shoes are required.

**Benefits**
============

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

**About Regal Rexnord**
=======================

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

 

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
==========================================

Regal Rexnord is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, ancestry, national origin, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status (unless required by the applicable law or government contract), disability or protected veteran status or any other status or characteristic protected by law. Regal Rexnord is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to building a team that represents diverse and inclusive backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan for protected veterans/individuals with disabilities or policy statement, please email Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity Posters 
 
 
 
**Notification to Agencies** : Please note that Regal Rexnord Corporation and its affiliates and subsidiaries ("Regal Rexnord") do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
**Overview**

My services have been retained to recruit a **Plant Manager** for one of the top mid-sized U.S. dairy manufacturing companies. Opportunity located in desirable Midwest **metropolitan community**.

The Plant Manager will report to the **COO** and oversee management-level associates and approximately **60 hourly employees** within a state-of-the-art, modern, recently expanded manufacturing facility. The successful candidate must have a strong track record of achieving long-term results in **budgeting, P&L, inventory control, quality, labor efficiency, and overall plant performance**. The candidate should also be highly knowledgeable in plant equipment and manufacturing operations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **4-5 years of Ice Cream, Yogurt, Novelties, or might consider Dairy Manufacturing experience**
* Minimum **5 years of upper-level management experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but not required
* Demonstrated ability to improve efficiency, profitability, quality, and overall plant performance

**Compensation:**

**$130,000–$170,000 base salary**, potentially flexible depending on experience, plus a **20% bonus opportunity**. A relocation package is available.

If you are an **over-achiever looking for a top-level Plant Management opportunity with a successful company that continues to grow**, I would welcome the opportunity to speak with you confidentially. Please Reply-Share Your Status. Send your resume and contact information to:

**Wade Palmer and Associates, Inc.**

**417-860-5607**

**wep@job-recruiters.com**

Pay: $130,000.00 - $170,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person
